text:
maya: customer hit a nasty one: sampleapp stream crashed behind a corp proxy. stack points to TextDecoder.decode throwing on chunk boundary.
eli: got a capture?
maya: pasted reduced server trace: 
```
OUT: data: {"id":7,"text":"Hey "}

OUT: data: {"id":7,"text":"\xF0\x9F\x98"}

OUT: data: {"id":7,"text":"\x8A"}

```
maya: proxy split a multi-byte emoji across reads and also emitted an empty event between fragments. our browser fetch path decodes per-chunk and blows up. node buffered so it survived. parity bug.
sam: naive split on "\n\n" + immediate JSON.parse is fragile. two fixes: streaming TextDecoder + leftover byte buffer, and tolerate empty events.
jonah: also saw auth-reconnect races: when we refresh token we open a new connection. server may emit a comment like ":resume 0xabc" and then continue. some clients merged leftover bytes from previous conn into resumed stream without reset, producing concatenated JSON objects `...\"lo\"}{\"id\":8...` that crash parser.
eli: agreed. plan: 1) use TextDecoder.decode(chunk, {stream:true}) and keep leftover Uint8Array for incomplete utf8; 2) accumulate text and split on double-newline but only attempt JSON.parse when we have a complete object (balanced-brace heuristic); 3) treat colon-leading comment lines that match /:resume|:auth-refresh/ as explicit reset points and call parser.reset(); 4) drop blank events.
sam: i'll implement a tiny shared createSseParser util for browser+node with feed(chunk)/reset() and callbacks onEvent/onComment. will export to sampleapp and browsersdk.
maya: please add diagnostic log when reset() happens so we can correlate customer logs.
eli: add unit+integration tests: proxy-mock that injects random CRLFs, splits utf8 sequences mid-codepoint, and inserts ":resume <token>" comments. run across win/chrome and node matrix.
ci-bot: queued job sampleapp-integration/sse-proxy-compression-matrix (4 jobs).
devx-bot: created RDW-2188: "sse: streaming-safe decoder, ignore blank events, reset on :resume to avoid reassembly merges" assigned to sam + eli.
jonah: small docs note in sampleapp README about proxies and streaming pitfalls would help new users.
sam: will open PR today with parser util, tests, and README blurb. aiming for low-risk, small change. :thumbsup:
